browser_smoke: Create a custom workspace and Run analysis.
Click Focus primary risk. Confirm the map opens, a target node receives the app-selected outline, inspector opens on that target, and audit gains FOCUS.
Click Propose repair before an agent proposal. Confirm accepted conclusion becomes selected, inspector opens it, audit gains a FOCUS event, and unusable human decision buttons are not shown.
Use a WebMCP-capable agent to call inspect_workspace.
Have the agent call triage_workspace with agent-supplied evaluations, then focus_items. Confirm triage badges, selected node, inspector and EVALUATE/TRIAGE/FOCUS audit events update.

Have the agent call propose_revision. Confirm PROPOSE_REVISION appears in audit, the suggested text appears in Human decision, and Use suggestion/Edit first/Keep current conclusion/Decide later are enabled.
Click Use suggestion. Confirm accepted conclusion changes only after the HUMAN click and SUPERSEDE/ACCEPT_REVISION audit events appear.
Confirm Select all still keeps all graph nodes selected for grouped drag.
